talia (People Ops): @here FYI Sydney office: planned generator maintenance Tue 2026-08-18 20:00-23:59. Building will stay open but some non-essential systems (floor lighting, pantry hot-water dispensers, select meeting-room AV) may be offline for short windows.

talia (People Ops): If you have after-hours candidate interviews, on-call duties, or vendor pickups that night, please flag them here so Facilities can coordinate.

sam (Facilities): Short notes: security and badge access unaffected. Generator test will include a 5-10 minute load-transfer at ~21:30. Expect a brief flicker and AV reboot in a few rooms. We recommend unplugging sensitive audio gear.

liam: I7m running a product demo at 21:00 for APAC partners. Can we get an AV-guard or reserve a generator-backed conference room?

sam (Facilities): @liam We can reserve Boardroom C (on UPS) for that slot. Please confirm by EOD Mon and Facilities will have tech on-site to assist.

anna: I7m on call and may need server-room key access. Will that be impacted?

sam (Facilities): @anna Server room on UPS and unaffected. On-call badge flow unchanged. If you need escorted physical access during the 21:30 transfer, request an escort here and we7ll coordinate.

talia (People Ops): Catering note: any hot-food vendors scheduled after 20:00 should avoid hot plates. Recommend insulated drop-off or schedule earlier. If your event needs warming, switch to Boardroom C or move to Wed.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Sydney Generator Maintenance (planned)" 2026-08-18 20:00-23:59. Location: Sydney Office.

talia (People Ops): Quick checklist: reply with :white_check_mark: if you need the UPS-backed room / an escort / vendor approval. We7ll post a final 12h reminder. Thanks!
